conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

cr_data.provenance: Doris Marguerite Brixey (died ca. 1984), New York; bequeathed to the Yale University Art Gallery, New Haven, Conn., 1984 (Source: Yale University Art Gallery, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Now owned by Mrs. Richard Brixey. . . . Information from Mrs. Brixey (on catalogue sheet for 'Ranchos Church, New Mexico' 1931) 'I also have another one a watercolor picture of a huge peach resting on tissue paper. It is a lovely one, I think. It is in the country and if you will send me another sheet like this one I will fill it out.'" (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication shows a portrait orientation with the peach near the bottom of the composition. Yale University Art Gallery shows it in landscape view with the peach in the left third of the composition. (Source: Information provided by Yale University Art Gallery, 2025)

description: A light yellow peach sits in partially unwrapped, crinkled white paper. A pale blue background stretches out behind the peach.
